items.text: Yeah, I spent 30 hours on this dang thing. But I spent 30 hours pretty much doing nothing. It's ultra janky, there's nothing really to do that feels... worth while or (in-game) tangible. The social interaction gameplay is an interesting idea, but difficult and more of a nuisance. The AI, when asked to do tasks is also sub par. I think it has a great idea and all, but at this point, it is a subpar experience. Edited part: I loathe the practice of version numbers not following conventional mathematical premises.
items.text_zh: 是啊，我在这鬼东西上花了30个小时。但我这30个小时基本上啥也没干。它超级粗糙，真的没什么事情做起来感觉……值得或者（在游戏里）有实感。社交互动的玩法是个有趣的想法，但很难搞，而且更像个累赘。AI在被要求执行任务时也低于水准。我觉得它有个很棒的点子之类的，但就目前而言，它是个低于水准的体验。编辑部分：我讨厌版本号不遵循传统数学前提的做法。

observations.description: 社交互动玩法虽然有趣但操作困难且令人烦恼
observations.evidence: The social interaction gameplay is an interesting idea, but difficult and more of a nuisance.
